print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Need to locate the playlist id for "Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes" in your Spotify library or public search</uncertainty>')

spotify_token = globals().get('spotify_token')

# 1) Search in your playlist library (private/owned) for exact title
playlist_title = 'Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes'

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_lib = []
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, query=playlist_title, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
    print('lib_page', page_index, 'count', len(res) if res else None)
    if not res:
        break
    all_lib.extend(res)
    if len(res) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

exact_lib = [p for p in all_lib if p.get('title') == playlist_title]
print('library_total', len(all_lib))
print('library_exact_title_count', len(exact_lib))
print('library_exact_playlists', [(p.get('playlist_id'), p.get('title')) for p in exact_lib[:10]])

# 2) Search public+private playlists as fallback for exact title
page_index = 0
all_search = []
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.search_playlists(query=playlist_title, access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by=None)
    print('search_page', page_index, 'count', len(res) if res else None)
    if not res:
        break
    all_search.extend(res)
    if len(res) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

exact_search = [p for p in all_search if p.get('title') == playlist_title]
print('search_total', len(all_search))
print('search_exact_title_count', len(exact_search))
print('search_exact_playlists', [(p.get('playlist_id'), p.get('title')) for p in exact_search[:10]])

# Choose playlist deterministically
chosen = None
if exact_lib:
    # if multiple, pick highest like_count then highest rating then earliest created_at then smallest id
    def sort_key(p):
        return (p.get('like_count',0), p.get('rating',0.0), p.get('created_at',''), -p.get('playlist_id',0))
    chosen = sorted(exact_lib, key=sort_key, reverse=True)[0]
elif exact_search:
    def sort_key(p):
        return (p.get('like_count',0), p.get('rating',0.0), p.get('created_at',''), -p.get('playlist_id',0))
    chosen = sorted(exact_search, key=sort_key, reverse=True)[0]

print('chosen_playlist', chosen.get('playlist_id') if chosen else None, 'title', chosen.get('title') if chosen else None)

print('<reflection>Playlist lookup completed. Selected playlist id based on exact title match and deterministic tie-breakers.</reflection>')

print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [Problem Solving Heuristics And Workflows]: apply selection criteria (most listened) by inspecting each candidate item before acting</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Assuming Spotify song details include play_count representing listens</uncertainty>')

playlist_id = 143
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
songs = pl.get('songs', [])
print('playlist_title', pl.get('title'))
print('candidate_song_count', len(songs))

song_stats = []
for s in songs:
    sid = s.get('id')
    # show_song is required to obtain play_count
    sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_stats.append({
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': sd.get('title'),
        'artists': [a.get('name') for a in sd.get('artists', [])],
        'play_count': sd.get('play_count')
    })

# Print stats for verification
for st in song_stats:
    print('song', st['song_id'], st['title'], 'play_count', st['play_count'])

# Select most listened
song_stats_sorted = sorted(song_stats, key=lambda x: (x.get('play_count', -1), x.get('title','')), reverse=True)
most = song_stats_sorted[0] if song_stats_sorted else None
print('most_listened', most)
